verdict.rationale: Okta's own docs establish the sign-in-once part of the story: users authenticate once and reach multiple connected apps. A hands-on community user confirms a Chrome plugin and a usable UI. No first-party evidence describes a launcher dashboard or app catalog showing a user's assigned apps. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the end-user dashboard/app launcher, documentation of the browser extension, evidence that the portal lists all assigned apps.

support.subject: As an employee, one portal holds my work apps — a launcher dashboard (and browser extension) where I sign in once and reach everything I'm assigned

citations.quote: Users authenticate once and gain access to multiple apps and services.
instead of signing in to every app, you can authenticate once with an identity provider (IdP). It provides access to all other connected service providers (SPs).
otherwise UI is acceptable and Chrome plugin is OKish.
